issue.title: Pin research-artifacts release builds to the release-please tagged commit
issue.description: Discovered by sase-1ml.land during post-start integration review, not caused by either diagram phase. At sase-research-artifacts da1c380, release exports only release_created and build uses actions/checkout@v4 with no ref. A static YAML inspection independently confirms release commit exported=False and build has explicit ref=False. The workflow was already this way before c56e3f7 (last pre-epic edit 1762395). When release-please creates a release for tagged commit R during a Publish run triggered by newer commit C, build packages C under the release version. Host sase commit 457dd728d5 fixes this exact mechanism: export the release-please SHA, require it for automatic releases, and check out it before building; manual publish_existing retains its dispatched-ref behavior. Port that bounded fix to the plugin and add a workflow contract regression. No publication was triggered for this audit. Size small: one known workflow selection defect and an existing host implementation to follow. All-status duplicate searches, the past-week sweep, and active epic scopes found no duplicate or causal active epic.

task_type_fields.impact: The published plugin wheel can contain commits newer than its tagged release, making release contents and provenance disagree.
task_type_fields.repro: Inspect jobs.release.outputs and the first build checkout at plugin da1c380: no release SHA is exported or selected. A run triggered at newer commit C can receive release_created=true for tagged R, yet its default checkout builds C. Compare the regression and fix in sase host commit 457dd728d5; no live publish was initiated.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1ml land audit compared host commit 457dd728d5 with the plugin and found the same pre-existing publication race remains in its workflow.
